name: kaelon
description: Kaelon — 3D custom PC configurator and e-commerce platform

scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npx prisma migrate deploy && node server/src/index.js
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
